scope: Known local user software/download/shader caches and user Temp metadata only; contents not read; no deletion/Git/host interaction
limitations: Cache location is not sufficient proof that each item is unused or safe to remove.
Conda package hardlinks may mean logical byte sums exceed actual recoverable allocation; installed environments are never proposed for deletion.
User Temp can include project evidence and live installers; requires exact provenance/process checks before removal.
All reports/errors and this script must be archived by coordinator.
